messages:
maya: Heads-up — ran long-stream comparison (FP16 hosted vs int8-local) on the new 70B-qa build. After ~25k prefix tokens the quantized run starts dropping user-system alignment; tokens 0..2 of cached prefix occasionally omitted from attention. Repro steps below.

sam: Hmm that sounds like a KV pointer arithmetic bug. Can you paste the minimal repro command?

maya: Sure — using repro runner: `tools/repro/run_long_stream.sh --model quant-70b --prefix-file tests/long_prefix/50k.json --streaming true --batch 1`

chen: Logs show `kv_index` jump when shard swap happens? paste from the quant run:
```
[2024-05-01 12:04:07] kv_index: 32768 -> 0 (wrap)
[2024-05-01 12:04:07] kv_write_pos: 32766
[2024-05-01 12:04:08] warning: prefill-trimmed 2 tokens
```

alex: Repro'd on my workstation with CPU sim; I saw the same `prefill-trimmed 2 tokens` 2/5 runs. Could be off-by-two when applying prefix eviction policy under streaming flush.

luis: Does this happen with FP16 host too, or only quant? If only quant maybe the pointer math after quantized memcpy (int4/int8 pack) is to blame.

maya: FP16 run was stable across 10 runs. Only quant (int8) fails. I added an assert in runtime: `assert(kv_write_pos + len <= kv_size)` — it trips on failing runs.

ci-bot: Created INF-2741: "kv-writepos wrap causes prefill token drop on quantized streaming" — https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2741 :eyes:

sam: Assign to eng-runtime, tagging @alex and @maya. Quick mitigation: enforce `prefill_keep = min(prefix_len, kv_size-4)` to avoid wrap until we patch.

maya: Will open a tiny PR with the mitigation and a failing unit test (tests/kv/test_stream_prefill_drop.py). Also adding a stress job in CI: `make test-longctx-quant`.

chen: Nice. For postmortem, capture token-level diffs using `tools/diff_tok.py --gold fp16.log --candidate quant.log` and save as artifact.

maya: Uploaded artifacts to build 4921. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1512 — includes repro and tombstone logs.

luis: :thumbsup: Let's run a 48h soak after the PR lands.

maya: Agreed. Will schedule ondedicated pool tomorrow.
